title: Major RNA Types: Structure, Function and Cellular Roles
method: Unicode lexical word count on 128 visible teaching-prose paragraphs only, excluding headings, tables, captions, SVGs, practice, answers, revision, citations, references and UI. Visible article count excludes SVG interiors and zoom buttons.
scientific_checks: Reviewed RNA directionality, hairpin complementarity and compensatory substitution
Compared bacterial, archaeal and nuclear eukaryotic RNA roles, including histone mRNA exception
Verified 70S/80S components, nonadditive sedimentation, Pol I precursor and separate Pol III 5S
Reviewed tRNA cloverleaf, L fold, CCA, anticodon polarity, identity and charged fraction
Distinguished U1/U2/U4/U5/U6 and C/D versus H/ACA guide roles, U3 exception
Reviewed tmRNA, mitochondrial guide RNA, SRP, RNA abundance and fractionation reasoning
Recomputed 18 model/example/practice quantities and checked original answer keys
limitations: Internal separate editorial self-review, not external peer review.
Authoritative textbook sections, paper abstracts and accessible reviews consulted; not all full original papers inspected.
MP SET comparator is the archived 2024 copy, not a newly verified MPPSC-hosted syllabus.
SVGs, anchors, reader and link checks are static source checks; interactive browser/mobile rendering and accessibility testing not performed.
